D/ [DN] VALEN S PF AVG ; R/ SECVRITAS REI PVBLICAE

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of Valens (364-378), Victory left, Reece period 19, mint of Aquilea, RIC vol. 9 page 96 no. 12[b]xvii, issue of 367-375. Obverse description: Bust draped pearl diademed and cuirassed right. Obverse inscription: [DN] VALEN S PF AVG. Reverse description: Victory advancing left with wreath and palm. Reverse inscription: SECVRITAS REI PVBLICAE. In exergue: .SMAQS. Diameter: 17.7mm, Weight: 2.62gms, die axis: 12
